[100]+"""HandlerProjectionMcpTools — project MCP tool registration events to the mcp_tools table.
[101]+
[102]+Consumes onex.evt.platform.node-registration.v1 events published by node_contract_registry,
[103]+filters for mcp_eligible entries, and UPSERTs into the mcp_tools snapshot table.
[104]+The projection is exposed through the projection API for the omnidash NC-07
[105]+widget (palette-hidden).
[106]+
[107]+Replay-safe and idempotent: re-processing the same registration event for a given
[108]+tool_name overwrites the existing row (UPSERT on tool_name).
[109]+"""
[110]+
[111]+from __future__ import annotations
[112]+
[113]+from datetime import UTC, datetime
[114]+
[115]+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

[180]+def _compute_freshness_state(
[181]+    emitted_at: str | None,
[182]+    now: datetime,
[183]+) -> EnumFreshnessState:
[184]+    """Compute freshness state based on event timestamp vs wall clock."""
[185]+    if emitted_at is None:
[186]+        return EnumFreshnessState.DEGRADED
[187]+
[188]+    try:
[189]+        event_ts = datetime.fromisoformat(emitted_at.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
[190]+    except ValueError:
[191]+        return EnumFreshnessState.DEGRADED
[192]+
[193]+    lag_seconds = (now - event_ts.astimezone(UTC)).total_seconds()
[194]+
[195]+    if lag_seconds <= MAX_LAG_SECONDS:
[196]+        return EnumFreshnessState.FRESH
[197]+    if lag_seconds <= DEGRADED_AFTER_SECONDS:
[198]+        return EnumFreshnessState.STALE
[199]+    return EnumFreshnessState.DEGRADED

[202]+class HandlerProjectionMcpTools:
[203]+    """Project MCP-eligible node registration events into the mcp_tools table."""
[204]+
[205]+    def handle(self, input_data: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, object]:
[206]+        """RuntimeLocal handler protocol shim.
[207]+
[208]+        Expects a DatabaseAdapter at input_data['_db'].
[209]+        Non-MCP events (mcp_eligible=False) are acknowledged with rows_upserted=0.
[210]+        """
[211]+        db_raw = input_data.pop("_db", None)
[212]+        if not isinstance(db_raw, DatabaseAdapter):
[213]+            raise TypeError("handle() requires a DatabaseAdapter in input_data['_db']")
[214]+        event = ModelMcpToolRegistrationEvent(**input_data)
[215]+        result = self.project(event, db_raw)
[216]+        return result.model_dump(mode="json")
[217]+
[218]+    def project(
[219]+        self,
[220]+        event: ModelMcpToolRegistrationEvent,
[221]+        db: DatabaseAdapter,
[222]+    ) -> ModelMcpToolsProjectionAppliedEvent:
[223]+        """UPSERT an MCP tool registration event.
[224]+
[225]+        Returns an applied event with rows_upserted=0 when the registration
[226]+        is not mcp_eligible — the event is acknowledged but nothing is written.
[227]+        """
[228]+        now = datetime.now(tz=UTC)
[229]+        now_iso = now.isoformat()
[230]+
[231]+        if not event.mcp_eligible:
[232]+            return ModelMcpToolsProjectionAppliedEvent(
[233]+                tool_name=event.node_name,
[234]+                rows_upserted=0,
[235]+                projection={},
[236]+                freshness_state=EnumFreshnessState.FRESH,
[237]+                applied_at=now_iso,
[238]+            )
[239]+
[240]+        status = EnumMcpToolStatus.ACTIVE
[241]+        if event.status in ("rejected",):
[242]+            status = EnumMcpToolStatus.REJECTED
[243]+
[244]+        # Extract supplementary fields from forwarded contract metadata.
[245]+        meta = event.contract_metadata
[246]+        description = str(meta.get("description", meta.get("tool_description", "")))
[247]+        model_id = str(meta.get("modelId", meta.get("model_id", "")))
[248]+
[249]+        projection = ModelMcpToolProjection(
[250]+            tool_name=event.node_name,
[251]+            description=description,
[252]+            model_id=model_id,
[253]+            correlation_id=str(event.correlation_id),
[254]+            status=status,
[255]+            is_active=status == EnumMcpToolStatus.ACTIVE,
[256]+            mcp_tags=event.mcp_tags,
[257]+            metadata=meta,
[258]+            registered_at=event.emitted_at or now_iso,
[259]+            projected_at=now_iso,
[260]+        )
[261]+
[262]+        freshness_state = _compute_freshness_state(event.emitted_at, now)
[263]+        row = projection.model_dump(mode="json")
[264]+        # mcp_tags stored as list for DB compatibility (JSONB / TEXT[]).
[265]+        row["mcp_tags"] = list(event.mcp_tags)
[266]+        db.upsert(TABLE, CONFLICT_KEY, row)
[267]+
[268]+        return ModelMcpToolsProjectionAppliedEvent(
[269]+            tool_name=event.node_name,
[270]+            rows_upserted=1,
[271]+            projection=row,
[272]+            freshness_state=freshness_state,
[273]+            applied_at=now_iso,
[274]+        )
[275]+
[276]+    def project_batch(
[277]+        self,
[278]+        events: list[ModelMcpToolRegistrationEvent],
[279]+        db: DatabaseAdapter,
[280]+    ) -> list[ModelMcpToolsProjectionAppliedEvent]:
[281]+        """UPSERT a batch of MCP tool registration events."""
[282]+        return [self.project(event, db) for event in events]
[283]+
[284]+
[285]+__all__: list[str] = [
[286]+    "HandlerProjectionMcpTools",
[287]+    "ModelMcpToolRegistrationEvent",
[288]+    "ModelMcpToolsProjectionAppliedEvent",
[289]+]
